sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

res = action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print("done:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('game_over'), last_action_result.get('run_complete'), last_action_result.get('reward'), last_action_result.get('done'))
seg=current_frame.segmentation
beam=[(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in('w','g') and n['pixels']<=4 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50 and n['boundary'][0][1]>16]
print("beam:", (min(c for r,c in beam),max(c for r,c in beam)) if beam else None)
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
        print("board", n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'][0])
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in('R','b','N') and n['boundary'][0][0]>50:
        print("hud", n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'][0])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
